test_title: PYST 17: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 28 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
If the given sheet is folded to form a cube, which among the given figures is NOT possible? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3c6b8a64fbda4ade2f7012272ce1b812dbb05f1da0e1b9b791020e968d7d768.png]
solution:
From the given open Dice:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d71ccfb46325da9dabe892774fe28c396e253a470fd0b04a2c38bca4a8906eb8.png] 

# and ! are the opposite sides.

$ and @ are the opposite sides.

& and % are the opposite sides.

And, two opposite sides can not be adjacent surfaces, so it can't be shown in a dice.

Now,

Option 1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45e3be29f4e438c760e50c6022a2afa11c4bf7a6d616e2752b67e802ff594a19.png] → Can be made, because all the surfaces are adjacent sides.

Option 2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f7aa56e12a99abfa3d9d843327d90884998f711669695e13e25f47d163e0f25.png] → Can be made, because all the surfaces are adjacent sides.

**Option 3)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/684e33ac248e8f70345932809524b6bb4e8e85e3fbba7354638a8221976833f5.png] →** ****Can not be made, because # and ! are the opposite sides.**

Option 4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb27f3d0bcc6f41b32862c4ead8331789d73cd6ba121a5371fd3b6754044828b.png] → Can be made, because all the surfaces are adjacent sides.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
